# newaitools.online

> A curated directory of the best AI tools, categories, and practical end-to-end workflows.

newaitools helps people discover, compare, and choose AI tools across 32 categories. It includes curated tool listings with pricing and descriptions, practical step-by-step AI workflows, and research-led blog articles.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.newaitools.online/): Main landing page with featured tools, category previews, and workflow highlights
- [Tools Directory](https://www.newaitools.online/tools): Searchable directory of all AI tools with filtering
- [Categories](https://www.newaitools.online/categories): Browse 32 AI tool categories organized by use case
- [Workflows](https://www.newaitools.online/workflows): Step-by-step AI workflow guides from idea to finished work
- [Blog](https://www.newaitools.online/blog): Research-led reviews, comparisons, and tutorials

## Categories

Writing & Text, Research & Knowledge, Image & Graphic Design, Video, Audio & Music, Coding & Development, Website & App Creation, Data & Analytics, Productivity, Business & Operations, Marketing & Advertising, Sales & CRM, Social Media, Education & Learning, Presentations & Documents, Automation & AI Agents, Customer Support, E-commerce, Finance, Legal, Healthcare, HR & Recruitment, IT & DevOps, 3D & Game Development, Translation & Localization, SEO, Meetings & Communication, Personal / Lifestyle, Scientific & Academic, Knowledge Management, Specialized Industry AI, AI Infrastructure / Models / APIs
